title: The Beginning of the End
summary: Crude tankers rates have weakened, but will it last? Today, for the first time since March 10, VLCC rates on the benchmark Arabian Gulf - China route have fallen below $100,000/day. Today, we assess VLCC earnings on this voyage at $76,500/day, some $33,000/day below yesterday's number.
